csvImport.title: Import CSV
csvImport.pickTitle: Choose a CSV file to import
csvImport.intro: Bring over flights from other logbooks: Volanta's import CSV, a SimToolkitPro or VA export (phpVMS) or VectaSim's own logbook CSV. Imported flights count towards hours, routes, fleet and countries – landing analysis, dispersion and approach stay empty because there is no recording.
csvImport.stkpHint: SimToolkitPro's columns are not documented – check the mapping in the next step.
csvImport.mappingIntro: Prefilled from {preset} and the column names. Date and time may be in one column or separate (then date + off-block time). If the arrival is missing, VectaSim calculates it from the block time.

shown.one: Shown: the first row. The whole file is counted and imported.
shown.other: Shown: the first {count} rows. The whole file is counted and imported.

csvImport.dedupe: Skip duplicates (same route, off-block less than 15 min apart)
csvImport.tagsHint: Every flight gets the tags “import” and the source. A landing rate from the file goes into the notes – it comes from a different measuring method and does not count for the landing statistics.
csvImport.noRows: The file contains no data rows.
csvImport.closeWhileImporting: The import is running – the window closes as soon as it is done.

user.title: You can find your pilot ID on simbrief.com under Account. It is saved.
user.missing: Enter your SimBrief pilot ID first

empty.title: No flight plan loaded
empty.text: Load your latest SimBrief flight plan to see route, remaining distance, ETA and plan vs. actual.
empty.idHint: You can find your pilot ID on simbrief.com → Account.

errors.dllMissingText: SimConnect is still missing – download it with one click under Settings → Simulator

dllMissing.title: SimConnect is still missing.
dllMissing.hint: Download it with one click under Settings → Simulator (official MSFS SDK from Microsoft) or pick the file there. To try things out: “Demo flight” on the map.

waitingForSim.title: Waiting for simulator …
waitingForSim.hint: Start the simulator – VectaSim connects automatically.
waitingForSim.hintRetry: Start the simulator – VectaSim connects automatically (next attempt in {seconds} s).

unknownProvider.title: Unknown simulator.
unknownProvider.hint: Pick an available simulator in Settings under “Simulator”.

simException.title: The simulator rejected a request.
simException.hint: Usually harmless. If it keeps happening, restart the flight in the simulator.

simQuit.title: Simulator closed.
simQuit.hint: Start the simulator again – VectaSim connects automatically.

simbriefNoId.title: No SimBrief pilot ID set.
simbriefNoId.hint: Enter your pilot ID or username (simbrief.com → Account).

simbriefNoPlan.title: No flight plan found.
simbriefNoPlan.hint: Check your pilot ID or create a flight plan on simbrief.com first.

simbriefFetch.title: SimBrief returned no flight plan.
simbriefFetch.hint: Create a flight plan on simbrief.com and load it again.

rateLimit.title: {service}: too many requests.
rateLimit.hint: VectaSim waits a moment and retries automatically.

unreachable.title: {service} is not reachable.
unreachable.hintIvao: No internet connection? IVAO traffic is paused, tracking continues locally. VectaSim retries automatically.
unreachable.hintOnline: No internet connection? Weather and VATSIM are paused, tracking continues locally. VectaSim retries automatically.
unreachable.hint: Check your internet connection and try again.

http.title: {service} responded with an error (HTTP {code}).
http.hintServer: The service is having problems right now. Try again later.
http.hintClient: Try again. If the error persists, check your input.

parse.title: The response could not be read.
parse.hint: Try again later. If the error persists, report it with the details below.

pathNotAllowed.title: This location is not allowed.
pathNotAllowed.hint: Pick a folder outside the Windows and program directories, e.g. Documents or the desktop.

flightNotFound.title: Flight not found.
flightNotFound.hint: It was probably deleted. The list is being refreshed.

dbLocked.title: The logbook is busy.
dbLocked.hint: Try again in a few seconds.

accessDenied.title: The file could not be written.
accessDenied.hint: Pick a different folder or close the file in other programs.

clipboardDenied.title: Clipboard access was refused.
clipboardDenied.hint: Click again while the VectaSim window is in the foreground.

unexpected.title: Unexpected error.
unexpected.hint: Try again. If the error persists, the text under “Details” helps with troubleshooting.

map.hidden: hidden on the map, polled every {seconds} s in the background

diag.label: Online traffic
diag.errorRepeated: Error ({times}× in a row): {error} · next attempt in {seconds} s

resume.title: Resume flight?
resume.body: {flight}. Recording stopped {ago} ago, {distance} from here. Without an answer, the rest counts as a new flight.
resume.bodySince: {flight} since {since}. Recording stopped {ago} ago, {distance} from here. Without an answer, the rest counts as a new flight.

gap.nextFlight: Next flight follows after {gap} – “Merge” above the logbook
gap.noShutdown: Ended without shutdown (crash, restart or reloaded flight)

statusButton.privacyTitle: Streamer mode on – registrations, callsigns, IDs and paths hidden. Click to turn off (Ctrl+Shift+P)
statusButton.setupTitle: Settings → Simulator: download SimConnect with one click
statusButton.connectTitle: Start a connection attempt now instead of waiting for the next automatic one

demo.startTitle: Try it without a simulator – a simulated approach into Frankfurt, landing after about 4 minutes
demo.banner: {demo} – the flight data is simulated. Demo flights stay in the logbook only until the demo ends and are then deleted.

online.off: Online traffic is off. You can also pick a network on the map next to “Traffic”.
online.hidden: Traffic is hidden on the map – {networks} keeps running in the background (flown track of clicked aircraft up to two hours).
online.noTraffic: No traffic in the map view

shell.flightDiscarded: Ground session discarded · no take-off, no flight – it is in the trash

resume.resumedBody: The recording continues the interrupted flight.

flightEvent.discarded: Ground session discarded (no take-off, in the trash)

landing.announce: {headline}. Landing rate {rate}, g-load {g}, {bounces}. Alt+T for the landing debrief.

tray.hiddenBody: The window is in the notification area. Double-click the icon to open it; “Quit” in its menu closes VectaSim.

quit.title: Recording in progress – quit anyway?
quit.message: The flight is aborted and saved in the logbook as interrupted.

update.toastBody: “Install now” downloads the update, backs up the logbook and restarts VectaSim.
update.recordingBody: Installing restarts VectaSim. Install version {version} after the flight under Settings → Updates.
update.backupFailed: Backup before the update failed – the update goes ahead anyway

conn.lostBody: Your flight is saved and continues as soon as the simulator is back.

privacy.onBody: Registrations, callsigns, airline, SimBrief ID and user paths are hidden.
privacy.offBody: Everything is shown in full again.

status.waitingText: Waiting for simulator – recording starts when you taxi

hint.simQuit: Simulator closed. VectaSim reconnects automatically as soon as it is running again.
hint.xplaneNotRunning: X-Plane is not running yet (or its Web API is off). As soon as X-Plane is running, VectaSim connects on its own.
hint.msfsNotRunning: The simulator is not running yet. As soon as MSFS reaches the main menu, VectaSim connects on its own.
hint.waiting: As soon as your simulator is running, VectaSim connects on its own. Recording starts when you taxi.

replay.label: Replay
replay.text: Replay · recorded raw data, no simulator
replay.hint: A recorded dump is playing. For real flights, stop the replay – the simulator is then detected automatically.

demo.text: Demo flight · simulated data, no simulator
demo.hint: A simulated flight to try things out: it starts in the air on the downwind for Frankfurt (runway 25C) and lands after about 4 minutes, then the next round begins. For real flights, stop the demo flight – the simulator is then detected automatically.

recording.label: Recording
recording.hint: Your flight is being recorded. You don't need to keep an eye on VectaSim for that.

suspended.label: Interrupted, will resume
suspended.text: Sim gone – flight saved, still running
suspended.hint: Sim gone – your flight is saved and continues as soon as the simulator is back.

ready.label: Ready
ready.text: Ready · recording starts when you taxi
ready.hint: Connected to the simulator. Recording starts automatically as soon as you taxi.
ready.hintSim: Connected to {sim}. Recording starts automatically as soon as you taxi.
